Provide output JSON plus source evidence and unresolved questions.

open_questions: Dates in ['Gültig ab (TT.MM.JJJJ)'] could be day-first or month-first; read as day-first: confirm
No SKU-like header found in root table; using 'Artikelnummer' as identity — confirm

notes: Artikelnummer values are zero-padded (00470001…00470012) although the profiler typed the column as int; they must be extracted as text so leading zeros survive and /sku stays a string.

Unresolved (amount): 'Nettopreis (de-DE)' is ambiguous. Under de-DE grouping the dot is a thousands separator, giving 1234–12234; read as a plain decimal it gives 1.234–12.234. The operator statement that the column uses de-DE grouping/conventions points to grouping, but the cells carry no comma or decimal part to confirm it. This needs an operator decision before publishing price amounts; confidence for /prices/*/amount is lowered accordingly.
VAT is explicit in the source, not inferred: 'MwSt enthalten' = Nein → vat_included false, and 'Steuersatz' = 5% → vat_rate 0.05 (fraction). These are fixture values, not tax advice.
Currency EUR comes from the explicit Währung column, not from the German headers; no FX conversion is performed.
Unit PCS is a constant source value already in the sell_unit enum_hint; no pack size column exists, so /unit/pack_size remains null.
Dates in Gültig ab are day-first per the header '(TT.MM.JJJJ)' and the operator note; 03.04.2026 → 2026-04-03. No effective_to column exists, so that price field stays null.
No inventory, promotion, category or barcode columns are present; those target arrays/fields are left empty rather than populated by inference.
One price row per SKU, so /prices has exactly one item per product with price_list 'standard' and effective_from 2026-04-03.

tables.reason: One row per article: unique Artikelnummer (00470001–00470012) and Bezeichnung per row, plus a single embedded price block (Preisliste, Nettopreis, MwSt enthalten, Steuersatz, Gültig ab). This is a product master with one price-list entry per SKU, not a dedicated pricing, inventory or promotion table.

columns.name: Artikelnummer
columns.reason: Header is the German article number; 12 distinct values, 1 per row, barcode-like with leading zeros (00470001). Must be read as text to keep the zeros; values match sku synonyms 'article' / 'item number'.

columns.name: Bezeichnung
columns.reason: 'Bezeichnung' = description/name; unique per article (SIM Artikel 1…12) and required by the contract.

columns.name: Währung
columns.reason: Single explicit value 'EUR' for all 12 rows — an explicit source currency code (ISO 4217 shape), not inferred from locale.

columns.name: Einheit
columns.reason: 'Einheit' = unit of measure; constant 'PCS' is in the contract's sell_unit enum_hint, so no conversion needed.

columns.name: Preisliste
columns.reason: 'Preisliste' is literally price list; constant 'standard' matches the contract default and the operator instruction to use price_list standard where stated. Identity key for /prices together with effective_from.

columns.name: Nettopreis (de-DE)
columns.reason: 'Nettopreis' = net price and the header declares de-DE conventions. Values run 1.234, 2.234 … 12.234 with no comma, so under de-DE grouping they would parse as 1234, 2234 … 12234 (dot = thousands separator), while a plain float read would give 1.234–12.234. The magnitude is not settled by the data alone; flagged as unresolved in notes rather than guessed.

columns.name: MwSt enthalten
columns.reason: 'MwSt enthalten' = VAT included; constant 'Nein'/'No' means the net price is VAT-exclusive, so vat_included = false.

columns.name: Steuersatz
columns.reason: 'Steuersatz' = tax rate; constant '5%' is an explicit source rate and should become the fraction 0.05 (fraction, not 5). The value is a fixture, not a real tax rate; no inference applied.

columns.name: Gültig ab (TT.MM.JJJJ)
columns.reason: 'Gültig ab' = valid from, and the header explicitly declares TT.MM.JJJJ (day.month.year); constant 03.04.2026 therefore parses day-first as 2026-04-03, not 2026-03-04.

changes_from_draft: Fixed /currency: was constant 'THB', now the explicit source value 'EUR' from Währung (no FX conversion).
Added /product_name from Bezeichnung (required by the contract, previously unmapped).
Added /unit/sell_unit via unit_normalize(Einheit) → PCS.
Replaced the empty collections with /prices (self-linked on Artikelnummer) carrying price_list, amount, vat_rate, vat_included and effective_from per SKU.

Amount: Nettopreis (de-DE) 1.234…12.234 parsed with de-DE grouping (dot removed before cast) → 1234…12234, per the header text, the operator note on de-DE conventions and the target schema id 'de_integer'.
vat_included: MwSt enthalten = 'Nein' → false (explicit source value).
vat_rate: Steuersatz '5%' → 0.05 fraction with a >=1 guard.

effective_from: Gültig ab parsed day-first with format %d.%m.%Y → 2026-04-03; the draft's date-order question is resolved by the header '(TT.MM.JJJJ)' and the operator note, so no date_format clarification is raised.
/sku kept as text (trim only); no strip_leading_zeros, so 00470001 stays 00470001; the draft's SKU-header question is resolved by the unique 1-per-row Artikelnummer column.
Added /status as the contract default 'active' with low confidence and an explicit note that it is a schema default, since the file has no status column.
Record dedupe on /sku; quality rules raised to error for the identity and required fields.
Inventory, promotions, category and barcode targets left absent — the file contains no such columns and they were not inferred.
